limits: Only four direct Function directories are selected; Function/prototype is outside this inventory.
All old policies and 7231 case fingerprints remain unchanged; 35 older passes are gained and two previously unsupported string-slice modes now reach failures.
The new 291 modes gain 157 passes; 47 modes remain metadata-excluded and three reach unsupported dynamic eval.

Source retention, Function.prototype.toString, literal unpaired surrogate source, destructuring, realms, Proxy, classes/super, generators/async functions and broader Annex B semantics remain incomplete.
Browser CSP retains its conservative all-script suppression, not complete unsafe-eval enforcement.
Resource-observation profiles retain their existing results and are not promoted to healthy gates.
Tests and local self-review do not establish complete memory accounting or independently audited security.
